name: concept journal
wording: the project's append-only event store of its design, read as a tolerant reader: versions of the purpose, each context's description and each concept, each with its reason, and every decision; the conceptual model, standing decisions and history are projections of it; holds no work, its examples files beside it; a change's entries travel with that change; append-only by construction, offering only appending verbs; warns of implementation leakage, never refusing
reason: The operator: each concept is an address plus a correction: the most precise established name as read within its bounded context, and a residue holding only the symmetric difference, its relations each stated once where owned, in the dense form of the canon's own values; the earlier restatement put the name before prose restating what the name already invokes, kept episodes and missed established names.
